question: Should QQBot adopt 16 MiB as its permanent inbound WebSocket message ceiling despite the absence of an authoritative QQ gateway maximum?
rationale: The code and proof establish that the mechanism works, but source inspection cannot decide the acceptable tradeoff between memory-exhaustion resistance and dropping unusually large valid QQ events.

options.title: Approve 16 MiB
options.body: Accept the demonstrated 16 MiB ceiling as a conservative channel policy aligned with existing OpenClaw precedent.

options.title: Choose More Headroom
options.body: Select a larger fixed ceiling and update the constant, assertions, and live proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for Contract Evidence
options.body: Pause the change until an authoritative QQ limit or production-size evidence supports a specific ceiling.

recommendation.title: Approve 16 MiB
recommendation.body: Accept the demonstrated 16 MiB ceiling as a conservative channel policy aligned with existing OpenClaw precedent.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced and substantially refactored the gateway lifecycle whose delivery and reconnect semantics are affected by this policy.
